Not really a game. It's an observable short film in VR.
It's a very charming story, and not very long either. It's perfect for those brand new to the VR experience.
Love the art style and direction.  Would certainly thow my wallet at PENROSE for a full length feature with this quality.

I hope to be able to develop, Hayao Miyazaki's fairy tale kingdom, Howl's Moving Castle, where I live and Hayao Miyazaki's cartoon character, through the door of the castle to a variety of scenes. World of Warcraft famous scenic spot.

I'm all for supporting indies, but at 3.99 I'm surprised it took approx 20 people to make this. It's padded out with floating objects which in vr is the norm, and there's literally no story to it. Had high hopes for this - the trailer is basically the 'game'.

It is beautifully done though, and if it had been longer and more involving probably would have paid a little more for it, too.

Far too short for $5, practically no story. It's a tech demo, not a "film". Very cool visuals though.

edit: refund offerered, totally recommended at the new price!
Title has been made free, so changing my recommendation to a yes as it is fun little movie.

Update - Now that the developer has changed the price, I would highly recommend this.  I can't wait to see other experiences from this developer, that's for sure.

While this is cute and I'm looking forward to more shorts like this in VR, I can not recommend this at $5.  It's only a couple of minutes in legth and you are done so you are paying over a $1/minute  If you see it on sale, say 50% or more off, then I would definently say check it out.  There are much better expierences at this price point and below.
